scope: Residual-learning methodological extension only; does not alter the primary S0/S1 evaluation or its frozen model registry.
target: Strict forward OOF residuals of T2_log1p 24-hour future spot Amihud from the nested selected SpotOnly model.
features: Derivative-only t-5..t histories for Funding, OI Log Change, Futures Taker Imbalance, Basis; frozen derivative innovations/interactions and calendar controls. No spot inputs.
training: Use earlier strict OOF residual rows only. Final evaluation uses F3 (2023-04-01 through 2023-06-30 20:00 UTC); training residual rows are F1 and F2. No F3 target is used for tuning.

quantum_kernel.feature_map: fixed Hadamard + Y-angle embedding + RZ(x/2) + cyclic CNOT ring fidelity kernel
quantum_kernel.landmark_rule: equally spaced row indices from the training block
quantum_kernel.solver: Nyström feature map followed by Ridge alpha=0.001
quantum_kernel.matched_classical: RBF Nyström kernel ridge, same training rows, PCA dimension, landmark count/rule and alpha

qnn.circuit: Y-angle embedding + two StronglyEntanglingLayers; Pauli-Z readout and linear scalar head
qnn.matched_classical: one-hidden-layer MLP with hidden width equal to qubit count, training-only PCA/scaling, same five seeds

hybrid_qnn.encoder: single linear layer from at most 16 training-only PCA features
hybrid_qnn.circuit: same shallow two-layer variational circuit as QNN
hybrid_qnn.matched_classical: one-hidden-layer MLP from the same 16 training-only PCA features, hidden width equal to qubit count, same five seeds

inference: For seed-based QNN/hybrid comparisons use the five-seed ensemble mean prediction and paired moving-block bootstrap with 1,000 draws and lengths 42/84. Report individual-seed dispersion; never select the best seed. Holm correct each asset within each QML family across the three qubit counts.
target_scaling: For QNN and matched classical MLP optimization, center and scale the residual target using only the training fold, then inverse-transform predictions before evaluation.
interpretation: Predictive comparison only. No hardware run and no quantum-advantage claim. This development holdout is not external confirmation.
